entry.title: RT Nik: You want to know why you’re still waiting for your alts to move and it feels like the ‘cycle’ hasn’t really begun for you yet? Because you...
entry.summary: RT Nik You want to know why you’re still waiting for your alts to move and it feels like the ‘cycle’ hasn’t really begun for you yet? Because you need a combination of two core things: an expanding business cycle & the nominal pool of dollars worldwide growing faster than the amount of goods and services it can purchase Dollar strength over the past ~4 months has caused Global M2 / Global GDP to shrink — much like it did in Q4 2016 before bottoming in Jan 2017 and continuing to expand The manufacturing sector is recovering, Copper/Gold looks like it’s bottomed, credit spreads are tight af, junk bonds are bouncing, inflation breakevens are rising and smallcaps have not even broken all-time highs yet — amongst many other things This is not what cycle tops look like for crypto more broadly
